measurement_notes: Model, two services, HTTP/WS clients, retained result metadata and tracemalloc share one process; RSS is not standalone worker memory.
Tracing starts after model load and first timeout recovery. It does not cover previous allocations or all native/CUDA memory.
Allocation tracing changes runtime overhead; do not compare throughput with the untraced30-request batch.
GC collected1122 objects with no observed RSS change. malloc_trim returned1 and released2014064640 RSS bytes; this proves reclaimable allocator pages at that point, not absence of all leaks.
No independent memory sample immediately after tracemalloc.stop; trace overhead cannot be isolated.
Only120 sequential requests with two public voices and three fixed texts; no multi-hour stability, physical sound or perceptual quality claim.
Trace locations retain only last two path components, not private absolute paths.
